**16.4. Calculation of the Jacobian Functions by Use of the Arithmetic-Geometric Mean (A.G.M.)**

For the A.G.M. scale see 17.6.

To calculate sn (_u|m\({}_{s}\)_),_ cn (_u|m\({}_{t}\)_),_ and dn (_u|m\({}_{s}\)_) form the A.G.M. scale starting with

**16.4.1**: \(a_{0}\)=1, \(b_{0}\)=\(\sqrt{m}_{1}\), \(c_{0}\)=\(\sqrt{m}\), terminating at the step \(N\) when \(c_{N}\) is negligible to the accuracy required. Find \(\varphi_{N}\) in degrees where

**16.4.2**: \(\varphi_{N}\)=2\({}^{N}a_{N}u\frac{180^{n}}{\pi}\) From these all the other functions can be determined.

**16.5. Special Arguments**
text:
JACOBIAN ELLIPTIC FUNCTIONS AND THETA FUNCTIONS (p.571)
16.4. Calculation of the Jacobian Functions by Use of the Arithmetic-Geometric Mean (A.G.M.)
For the A.G.M. scale see 17.6.
To calculate sn(u|m), cn(u|m), and dn(u|m) form the A.G.M. scale starting with
16.4.1  a_0=1,\ b_0=\sqrt{m_1},\ c_0=\sqrt m,
terminating at the step N when c_N is negligible to the accuracy required. Find \varphi_N in degrees where
16.4.2  \varphi_N=2^Na_Nu\,\frac{180^\circ}{\pi}
and then compute successively \varphi_{N-1},\varphi_{N-2},\dots,\varphi_1,\varphi_0 from the recurrence relation
16.4.3  \sin(2\varphi_{n-1}-\varphi_n)=\frac{c_n}{a_n}\sin\varphi_n.
Then
16.4.4  \mathrm{sn}(u|m)=\sin\varphi_0,\ \mathrm{cn}(u|m)=\cos\varphi_0,\ \mathrm{dn}(u|m)=\frac{\cos\varphi_0}{\cos(\varphi_1-\varphi_0)}.
From these all the other functions can be determined.
16.5. Special Arguments
Columns: u | sn u | cn u | dn u
16.5.1  0 | 0 | 1 | 1
16.5.2  \tfrac12K | 1/(1+m_1^{1/2})^{1/2} | m_1^{1/4}/(1+m_1^{1/2})^{1/2} | m_1^{1/4}
16.5.3  K | 1 | 0 | m_1^{1/2}
16.5.4  \tfrac12(iK') | im^{-1/4} | (1+m^{1/2})^{1/2}/m^{1/4} | (1+m^{1/2})^{1/2}
16.5.5  \tfrac12(K+iK') | 2^{-1/2}m^{-1/2}[(1+m^{1/2})^{1/2}+i(1-m^{1/2})^{1/2}] | (m_1/4m)^{1/4}(1-i) | (m_1/4)^{1/4}[(1+m_1^{1/2})^{1/2}-i(1-m_1^{1/2})^{1/2}]
16.5.6  K+\tfrac12(iK') | m^{-1/4} | -i(\tfrac{1-m^{1/2}}{m^{1/2}})^{1/2} | (1-m^{1/2})^{1/2}
16.5.7  iK' | \infty | \infty | \infty
16.5.8  \tfrac12K+iK' | (1-m_1^{1/2})^{-1/2} | -i(m_1^{1/2}/(1-m_1^{1/2}))^{1/2} | -im_1^{1/4}
16.5.9  K+iK' | m^{-1/2} | -i(m_1/m)^{1/2} | 0

Columns: function | m=0 | m=1
16.6.1  sn(u|m): \sin u | \tanh u
16.6.2  cn(u|m): \cos u | \mathrm{sech}\,u

16.6.7  dc(u|m): \sec u | 1

16.6.9  sc(u|m): \tan u | \sinh u
16.6.10  ns(u|m): \csc u | \coth u
16.6.11  ds(u|m): \csc u | \mathrm{csch}\,u
